name: Imum Coeli
defines: Your private foundation: home, family and where you come from.

signs.aries: You come from somewhere combative or self-starting, and you recharge by doing something physical rather than by resting.
signs.taurus: Your roots are in something tangible and unchanged, and alone you want familiar surroundings, familiar food and no surprises.
signs.gemini: Your beginnings were talkative and unsettled, and even by yourself your mind keeps up a commentary you cannot switch off.
signs.cancer: You come from a strong emotional inheritance, and what restores you is being somewhere that already knows you.
signs.leo: Your earliest sense of yourself was formed by being noticed, and in private you still want a small audience of people who love you.
signs.virgo: Your foundations were laid by being useful, and you settle yourself by tidying, mending or putting something back in order.
signs.libra: You come from a background where peace was kept, and you cannot rest anywhere that is visually or emotionally jarring.
signs.scorpio: There is something at the bottom of your history that was never said aloud, and your innermost self is guarded even from you.
signs.sagittarius: Your origins are elsewhere, or you have travelled a long way from them, and you restore yourself by getting out rather than by going back.
signs.capricorn: You grew up on the wrong side of the responsibility line, and you are still privately building the security you did not start with.
signs.aquarius: You came out of something that did not fit the neighbourhood, and your innermost self is more detached than the one you show.
signs.pisces: Your beginnings are hazy or idealised, and what restores you is water, sleep and nobody needing anything from you.
